title: Lovely Crunchy Mexican Poblanos Fajitas
description: A kid-friendly Mexican dish featuring crunchy poblano peppers and a rich umami flavor, made with unsweetened cocoa and pressure-cooked for tender results.
instructions: Roast the poblano peppers in the oven at 400 degrees Fahrenheit for 30 minutes, then peel and slice them into strips.
In a large bowl, mix together the sliced onion, minced garlic, and a pinch of salt.
Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat, then add the onion mixture and cook until the onions are translucent.
Add the ground beef to the skillet, if using, and cook until browned, breaking it up into small pieces as it cooks.
Add the roasted poblano peppers, unsweetened cocoa powder, and a pinch of black pepper to the skillet, and stir to combine.
Pressure-cook the mixture for 10 minutes, or until the flavors have melded together and the peppers are tender.
Warm the tortillas by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Assemble the fajitas by placing a portion of the pepper mixture onto a tortilla, topping with shredded cheese, and serving immediately.
